events.title: Pilates World Record Attempt
events.source: manx radio & visit isle of man & allevents (peel) & visitor events calendar
events.description: Pilates World Record Attempt, Wellness Festival & Charity Village Overview: On the 19th of July, Isle of Man to Host World Record Pilates Class in Global Homecoming at Knockaloe. 34Moves, in collaboration with Ramsey Crookall and Visit Isle of Man, plans to establish not only the world record for the largest Pilates class but also to host a global Pilates homecoming to Knockaloe on the Isle of Man. This attempt to break the current world record of 3,486 participants will be led by top instructors from around the world, offering an enjoyable, inclusive, wellness-focused experience for beginners and experts of all ages, backgrounds, and abilities to come together in unity and movement. Pilates & The Isle of Man: People may be unaware that Pilates' origins are closely linked to Knockaloe and the Isle of Man. Knockaloe holds a prominent place in the Island’s history, demonstrating the impact of global conflicts on individuals and ideas. It was home to the world’s largest civilian internment camp during WWI, bringing together extraordinary men with diverse skills, creativity, and resilience through their detention. Among these men was Joseph Pilates, who began developing his physical training system rooted in physical and mental wellness, which eventually became known as Pilates and is now practised by millions worldwide. Knockaloe exemplifies how hardship can lead to innovation, cultural exchange, and a lasting global influence, and how one man’s commitment to health and discipline ignited a movement. World Record Attempt: This world record attempt aims not only to bring together people of all ages but also to showcase the Isle of Man as a destination where nature, wellbeing, and community come together. It is more than just a fitness event; it aims to establish the Isle of Man as a centre for mindful tourism and contemporary movement culture. At 14:00, participants will come together to attempt to break the current world record of 3,486 people in a single Pilates class. The class will: - Be guided by leading Pilates teachers from around the world - Focus on unity, presence, and mindful movement - Celebrate Pilates as it was originally intended — accessible, empowering, and grounded in wellbeing - No prior Pilates experience required! Note: You will be provided a t-shirt for the world record attempt! More details to follow on collection. The t-shirt MUST be worn for the pilates world record attempt! Wellness Festival & Charity Village: Alongside the world record attempt, the venue will host a Wellness Festival & Charity Village that will offer a vibrant range of physical, mental, and emotional well-being activities. The festival will emphasise local producers, businesses, and charities, with stalls showcasing Manx food, drinks, crafts, products, wellness services, and charitable initiatives. The Village aims to promote connection, balance, and sustainable living, while proudly highlighting the Isle of Man’s unique UNESCO Biosphere status. Running throughout the day, the Wellness Festival & Charity Village will showcase a mix of: - Isle of Man food & drink - Celebrate Isle of Man heritage and culture. - Local & international wellness brands and practitioners - Crafts, products, and experiences - Charities and community initiatives - Spaces for rest, connection, and inspiration Please note: Exhibitors, teachers, and the full event line-up will be announced gradually over the coming months, with regular updates shared via email and official event channels. The Event: 10:00 – Wellness festival & charity village opens Morning – Early Afternoon – Wellness activities, movement sessions & festival experiences 14:00 – World record pilates class attempt 14:30 – 17:00 – Festival continues, closing celebrations & community connection 17:00 – Event close Who Is This Event For? - Everyone, local and visitors alike - Pilates practitioners and teachers - Beginners curious about Pilates - Wellness enthusiasts - Anyone drawn to movement, history, and meaningful experiences Annoucements: Upcoming announcements will include: ✔️Festival Exhibitors ✔️ Special guests, celebrities & partners ✔️ International expert instructors showcasing from around the world All will be revealed over the coming months — this page will be updated regularly, and newsletters will be sent out to ticket purchasers. events.title: Lloyd Cole
events.description: Lloyd Cole will take to the road in 2026 with a run of solo shows. His elegant solo live performances in recent years have been predominantly acoustic, but for these concerts he has decided to go electric. The performance will run the gamut from his masterful debut with the Commotions ‘Rattlesnakes’ right up to 2023’s acclaimed ‘On Pain’ touching on all points in between. Says Lloyd: “In 1999, in retreat from mainstream ambivalence, the idea of becoming a troubadour was perversely alluring. Two acoustic guitars, a suitcase, and a round the world ticket. It took a while for me to become comfortable with it, but The Folksinger Show became my staple. And then, somehow or other, twenty-five years were gone, and now I find myself approaching the end of my career, and wanting to be seen more as just a singer, who wrote a body of work, very little of which one would reasonably label ‘folk’. So I’m back with my Telecaster, my Princeton amp, and my solo show is now electric.”

events.title: Yn Chruinnaght Celtic Gathering
events.source: visit isle of man & peel online & visitor events calendar
events.description: Yn Chruinnaght Celtic Gathering: A Celebration of Music, Dance & Culture This July, you’re invited to the heart of the Celtic world, right in the middle of the Irish Sea, for a week-long celebration of traditional music, dance, language and folklore at Yn Chruinnaght Celtic Gathering in the Isle of Man. For nearly 50 years, Yn Chruinnaght–meaning “The Gathering” in Manx Gaelic–has brought together friends from across the Celtic nations: Ireland, Scotland, Wales, Cornwall, Brittany and the Isle of Man. This year’s festival takes place from 27 July – 2 August in Peel and Douglas, offering concerts, ceilis, music sessions, lectures and workshops, alongside an opportunity to explore our enchanting island. Festival highlights will include a sea-themed Celtic variety concert, two large ceilis, an inter-Celtic film night, traditional produce show and the vibrant Peel Carnival. This year’s performers include Manx/Irish duo Isla Callister and Cathal Ó Curráin, Orcadian musicians Saltfishforty, Welsh mother and daughter Delyth and Angharad Jenkins on harp and fiddle, Manx Gaelic groove from Clash Vooar, young Dublin band Filidh, the Mega Manx Ceili Band and Scottish accordion legend Sandy Brechin. A special focus for 2026 will be Blein ny Gaelgey – Year of the Manx Language, and Culture Vannin’s Manx Language Summer School, which will also offer lessons through Irish, will run alongside the festival.

events.title: Scoill Souree - Manx Summer School for IRISH SPEAKERS
events.description: Scoill Souree - Manx Summer School for IRISH SPEAKERS As part of celebrations for Blein ny Gaelgey, the Year of the Manx Language, Culture Vannin will be running a Manx language course through Irish at its annual Scoill Souree – Manx language Summer School for adults. The course has been designed for those who are new to Manx, or at an early beginner level, who approach learning as Irish-speakers and will take place between Tuesday 28th - Friday 31st July (9.30am - 1.15pm each day). Scoill Souree coincides with the wonderful Yn Chruinnaght Celtic Gathering festival, and both the summer school and festival will take place in the beautiful sea-side town of Peel. The festival offers wonderful performances of music and dance, and will also include an interceltic film night on Wednesday 29th July. Ceilis, workshops, talks and sessions are also a fixture of the festival, and there are many opportunities to practise your Manx! The course will be delivered by Dr Natalie Nic Shim (Simpson), an Irish translator and Manx speaker. With a practical focus, the course will be interactive, with lots of opportunities to practise speaking and listening. The course lines up with transport links from both the north and south of Ireland. Each course costs £150 per person; this includes tuition, learning materials, and light refreshments in breaks. A limited number of bursaries are available for students and anyone with low income on a first-come first-served basis. Though the courses are not accredited, a certificate of attendance will be presented to participants upon completion of the summer school. events.description: Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark (OMD), the synth-pop duo from Wirral, England, pioneered their genre combining massive chart success with experimentation on albums such as "Organisation"(1980) “Architecture and Morality” (1981) and “Dazzle Ships” (1983). Hits such as “Enola Gay”, “Maid of Orleans”, and ‘Souvenir’ propelled them into the stratosphere and helped shape the musical landscape of the eighties. In 1986 OMD conquered the United States, and yielded the hit, "If You Leave" from the Pretty In Pink Soundtrack... Following the celebration of their 40th anniversary, OMD returned in 2023 with their first new studio album since 2017's highly praised The Punishment Of Luxury, a record entitled Bauhaus Staircase. The record is regarded as OMD's most explicitly political record and the crowning achievement of their desire to be both Stockhausen and Abba - born from the impetus to kickstart new explorations during lockdown when, as Andy McCluskey admits: "I rediscovered the creative power of total boredom." It shows the band to be one of the few of their generation still able to create music that inspires and was received to critical and fan acclaim. In January 2024 they hit the road to play their largest and most successful UK tour to date, culminating in their biggest ever London show at the O2 arena. US touring followed with spectacular performances at LA’s Dark Wave and Cruel World festivals, and sold out consecutive nights at the Greek Theatre Over the past four decades — give or take a decade break —the band have sold over 40 million records worldwide, establishing them as electronic synthesiser pioneers and one of Britain’s best-loved pop groups. OMD's set is full of energy and loaded with their hits, so bring your dancing shoes!

events.description: Little Makers - Strawberry Planter Workshop Create and decorate your own strawberry-themed ceramic flowerpot in this hands-on workshop. Each pot features a raised strawberry design, ready for you to bring to life with colour, patterns, and your own ideas. Use paints and pens to design bold fruit patterns, decorate the leaves and seeds, or turn your pot into something completely different. Once finished, you can take it home and use it for a small plant or succulent. This session focuses on creativity, colour, and simple making skills in a relaxed environment. Decorate a strawberry-themed ceramic flowerpot Use paints and pens to create your own designs Take home a finished pot ready for a small plant Create a handmade gift or personal keepsake Rushen Abbey has a strong link with the Isle of Man’s food history. Just down the road in Ballasalla, the former jam factory once produced large quantities of fruit preserves, at its peak reaching up to 14 tons of bottled fruit each year. Run by Messrs Woods and Hardon, it gained national recognition for its quality, winning a gold medal at the Liverpool Exhibition in 1886. This workshop takes inspiration from that local heritage, giving a nod to the Isle of Man’s fruity past while you create your own strawberry-themed designs. events.description: LOL Comedy Night with Jamie Sutherland, Mick Ferry & Sol Bernstein! A night of live stand-up comedy with top national acts!About this EventIf it's more laughter you're after, join us for another dedicated night of pure comedy - we've lined up THREE of the funniest after-dinner comics for you! Hosted by comedian and Everton football club MC, Jamie Sutherland, and they will have you falling off your seats!Jamie SutherlandLiverpool has a history for producing some of the countries finest comedy talent, and Jamie Sutherland can now be added to that fine listA headline act on the comedy circuit, working for some of the countries finest clubs. Jamie is also a corporate hospitality MC at Everton FC, for all their home games.A very original act, who will keep you amused with gags, tales, and stories. Jamie is a modern act, with many observational topics, and up to date material, and dont worry if you prefer a good old style gag, he has plenty of them thrown in, ensuring a performance that will touch everyones buttons.He has supported some of the biggest names in comedy, and has gained a reputation as one of the rising stars of comedy with the sell out crowds and his fellow comedians.Mick FerryIn the spring of 1997 Mick set foot on stage for the very first time at the legendary Frog and Bucket. It has led to a career that has seen him perform all around the world. He is one of the most sought after comperes and headliners in the UK and writes regularly for some of the biggest names in stand up comedy and he has appeared on many tv shows.Completely at ease with any audience, Mick has an effortless ability to pluck material from thin air.A supremely talented performer, Mick is a member of the esteemed Cutting Edge Show at The Comedy Store. It’s a furiously fast paced topical team show that relies on its members being quick witted and Mick continues to hone his off the cuff spontaneous acerbic and razor sharp outbursts.Sol BernsteinWhen a legend reaches a certain point in their career, it’s time to ease up on doing legendary things and reflect on an exemplary life. Sol Bernstein has reached that point, and he invites us to listen to his tales of the high life with the biggest names in showbiz, musings on how the world has changed, and being just an ordinary Jew with world-beating wit, unbounded talent and death-defying chutzpah.But despite such a life, Sol has suffered an unforgiveable injustice. Heard of Elvis Presley? No? How about The Beatles? Really? Ok then, surely Marcel Marceau? Good. Well Sol Bernstein launched the careers of these greats and many more, and what did he get for it? Nada. Nothing, not even a ‘thank you’. But having escaped the Pogroms in Russia and the Nazis in Germany as a child, Bernstein is no stranger to pain, and hardships – in all their forms – have made the man what he is. Such struggles – be they life-threatening or merely female nagging – give Sol Bernstein not only the inspiration to face each new day but the material for his limitless supply of comedy shtick. The resulting performances – not to mention charisma alone – have given the man good reason to enjoy fame and build friendships with, among so many, the likes of Burt Bacharach, James Brown and Harry Hill.He’s got so much to say and – being now in his 80s – so little time to say it. Catch this legend and genius while you still have the chance. Also check out other in Douglas, Comedy events in Douglas, Entertainment events in Douglas.

events.title: 2026 Nowthen Threshing Show
events.venue: 7415 Old Viking Blvd Nw, Nowthen, Mn, United States, Minnesota 55330
events.description: 2026 Nowthen Threshing Show Welcome to the 55th Annual Nowthen Threshing Show! This year featuring John Deere tractors and engines. Founded in 1837 by Vermont blacksmith John Deere in Grand Detour, Illinois, the company revolutionized agriculture with the first commercially successful self-scouring steel plow, designed to cut through sticky Midwestern soil. After moving to Moline, IL, in 1848 for better transportation, the company grew, incorporating as Deere & Company in 1868. Key Historical Milestones: 1837: John Deere creates the first steel plow from a broken saw blade, solving the issue of dirt sticking to cast-iron plows. 1848: Operations move to Moline, Illinois, to access water power and rail transportation. 1868: The business is incorporated as Deere & Company. 1918: John Deere enters the tractor business by purchasing the Waterloo Gasoline Engine Company. 1956: The company begins global expansion, opening its first foreign manufacturing plant in Mexico and acquiring a German tractor firm. 1990s-2000s: Introduction of GPS, GreenStar precision technology, and AutoTrac automated steering transforms the company into a leader in digital, data-driven agriculture. Today, Deere & Company is the world's leading manufacturer of agricultural machinery, widely recognized for its green and yellow equipment and the "Nothing runs like a Deere" slogan. We're hoping to showcase many examples of John Deere history at the 2026 Nowthen Threshing Show. We hope to see you there.

A modern-day troubadour with a decade of touring behind him, Joe has played to tens of thousands across the UK, Europe and Nashville — including legendary venues on Music Row. His collaborations with top Nashville writers such as Johnny Garcia (Garth Brooks), Jill Collucci and Aaron Raitiere have helped shape his cinematic, story‑driven sound. events.title: John Bramwell - I am Kloot
events.description: As the singer in I Am Kloot from 1999 to 2014, John Bramwell achieved a Mercury Prize nomination for 2010’s 'The Sky At Night', a Top 10 chart position for 2013’s 'Let It All In', numerous UK and European tours and a triumphant farewell at the Queen Elizabeth Hall with an orchestra in 2014. Now, as a solo artist, Bramwell travels a very different path, a path that criss-crosses the length and breadth of the UK with a humble agenda of taking his heart-warming songs to the stage and enjoying another moment in time with his devoted fans. The stunning 2023 sophomore solo album, 'The Light Fantastic' was an almost complete U-turn from the I Am Kloot outlook they were known for. Darker clouds banished and in replacement strings, four-part harmonies (a warming development, since Kloot never had any backing vocals) and a dozen gloriously exhilarating, beautifully crafted and observed songs about life, humanity, the universe and everything. As John put it, “It’s been great to find the joy of making music once again. These are the most uplifting songs of my career.” The album received unanimous praise from the UK press but it is the all-encapsulating live show where Bramwell conjures up his true magic as songwriter and performer. Bramwell has been on a never-ending rolling adventure since his workings away from Kloot and in the last three years has visited almost every parish in England, Scotland and Wales to be met with halls, theatres, arts centres, churches, festival tents and folk clubs full with his eager fans waiting to see which direction Bramwell will take the mood of the night – the enriched, wildly playful inter-song banter is so good, a stand up comedy tour has been contemplated. Bramwell’s razor sharp wit, on the line and refreshingly true (and often hilarious) observations and instantly recognisable haunting vocal channelled through some of the most honest and direct song writing of our times has seen Bramwell championed in rave reviews, time after time. Most recently, God Is In The TV celebrated John’s 2025 'Beautiful Days' performance as the highlight of the weekend.

events.title: Under the Sea: Watercolour Painting: 12th September
events.description: Under the Sea: Watercolour Painting: 12th September De-stress watercolour meditation Perfect with friends and family! Dive into the serene world of watercolour painting with our captivating afternoon workshop, designed specifically for adults with a passion for the ocean. Explore the depths of your creativity by bringing the enchanting underwater realm to life. This workshop will guide you through the process of crafting stunning, sea-inspired masterpieces using watercolour techniques and other creative mediums. Join our gentle painting workshop, as we delve into an afternoon of meditative watercolour bliss! Create ethereal watercolour paintings depicting the big blue sea! Follow our prompts or go off piste - our palette of colours will include green + blue + magical silver hues crafting a whimsical underwater tableau Perfect for all levels of experience! During the workshop, participants will engage projects designed to ignite creativity and refine their skills. These include: Welcome and Introduction Basics of Watercolour Techniques Understanding Colour Theory with an Ocean Palette Sketching Sea Life: Fish, Coral, and More Guided Practice: Painting a Simple Sea Creature Enjoy mindful watercolour exploration and engage in a calming session where you let your brush flow intuitively, focusing on the meditative quality of watercolours. Discover how to take advantage of unexpected "mistakes" while you study the basics and go beyond traditional watercolour by experimenting with different materials and a modern approach + use colour combinations that reflect your personality + be your own kind of magic. In this painting workshop you will be encouraged embrace a free approach to painting + relax during wonderful process + abandon + embrace a wabi-sabi style of watercolour painting + create soft layers of watercolour on quality paper + try a few other paint alchemy to create interesting effects all inspired by the starry night sky. Watercolour has a beauty, a luminance & unparalleled uniqueness. Let your paper come alive with translucent layers of singing colour! You will explore the meditative practice of water colour painting, learn to handle the paint, be guided by professionals to develop a newly found interest from beginner to improver to confident maker in art - advice on tools and materials and lots more! Watercolour is an incredibly fun and meditative medium (trust us!) and you are sure to have an afternoon of relaxed, paint play, to create a few art pieces to give as gifts or frame and keep for yourself! Instruction by Kate Jerry You may also like the following events from Artreach Studios:Next month, 3rd July, 06:30 pm, Friday Art Night - Vincent Van Gogh "Sunflowers": 3rd July in PeelNext month, 27th July, 09:00 am, Summer: ★ It's A Wild Life ★ Art Camp for Children: 27th July - 30th July in PeelAlso check out other Arts events in Peel, Fine Arts events in Peel, Workshops in Peel.

events.title: Frank Bruno, MBE "My Life and Times"
events.description: Frank Bruno, MBE "My Life and Times" In association with GRAIN and VINE, Ale and Cocktail House From the tough streets of Hammersmith, London, young Frank Bruno channelled his energy into boxing at just nine years old. A "problem child" who found focus at a special school, he became the youngest-ever Amateur British Champion at 18. Turning pro in 1982, "True Brit" exploded onto the scene with a staggering 21 consecutive knockout wins — 38 of his 40 career victories ended inside the distance, showcasing one of the most fearsome punching powers in heavyweight history. He thrilled millions at sold-out arenas, battling legends like Mike Tyson (twice) and Lennox Lewis. After three heartbreaking world title challenges, Bruno finally lived the dream in 1995, outpointing Oliver McCall at Wembley Stadium to claim the WBC Heavyweight Championship — only the third Briton ever to do so. The roar of the crowd that night still echoes. But Frank's greatest fight came outside the ring. Diagnosed with bipolar disorder, he faced mental health battles with raw honesty and courage. Today, as an MBE and founder of The Frank Bruno Foundation, he champions awareness, using boxing to support others. Big, bold, humorous and unbreakable — Frank Bruno is British boxing royalty with stories of glory, grit and hope that will captivate every guest. Don't miss this unforgettable night with one of the UK's favourite "National Treasures" Hosted by Dave Moore Tickets are priced @ £ 25-00 (with 100 "Early Bird" Tickets @ £ 20-00) and will be available from 10am on Tuesday 21st April from: https://www.villagaiety.com/ Our generous main sponsors for this event are: Grain and Vine, Ale and Cocktail House, 6 Victoria St who will be hosting our VIP "Meet and Greet" with Frank @ 5pm til 630pm on the Sunday afternoon. events.title: Space - Ten Neurotic Fairytales
events.description: Celebrating 30 years since the release of their breakthrough album Spiders, Space return to the stage on their 2026 UK tour, bringing with them a brand-new studio album, Ten Neurotic Fairytales, released September 2026. The new record sees the band return to the unmistakable sound that made them one of the most distinctive acts of the 1990. Sharp melodies, dark humour and surreal storytelling that dominated Radio 1, Virgin Radio, Top of the Pops, TFI Friday and The Big Breakfast. Long-time fans can expect a set that blends classic hits with fresh material from the new album. The album and tour artwork has been created in collaboration with Jonny Vegas, drawing inspiration from original models and artwork associated with the bands early visual identity reimagined for a new era. With over 5 million albums sold worldwide, Space boast an incredible catalogue including Spiders, Tin Planet, Suburban Rock and Roll, Attack of the Mutant 50ft Kebab, Give Me Your Future and Music for Pleasure, Music for Pain. Both Spiders and Tin Planet achieved Double Platinum status in the UK, while 90s classic Female of the Species remains a defining track of the era. events.description: The Manx Breast Cancer Support Group are really pleased to be bringing ‘Rule The World’ to the Isle of Man. events.title: Boxing Day Cammag
events.description: Isle of Man Orienteering Klubb - Boxing Day Orienteering Event - Archallagan Forest. Boxing Day Orienteering Event at Archallagan Forest. Saturday 26th December 2026. Family friendly orienteering activity suitable for all ages. • Find as many controls as you can in 1 hour! • Mass START. • Activity suitable for Families, Individuals & Groups. • Your choice to Walk, Jog or Run. • Wear suitable clothing and footwear for weather conditions & time of year. • Children must be under the supervision of an adult. • Compass is optional, to assist with navigation. Registration time: 9:30am - 10:20am. Mass START at 10:30am. Participants must return to the finish within 1 hour to avoid a time penalty! All participants must report to the finish by 11:30am at the latest even if they do not complete their course. Orienteering Maps supplied - Cost: Adult: £4.00. Youth under 18yrs: £1.50. Family (2 Adults & Children under 18yrs): £8.00 (max) (Note: Additional adults in family group pay adult fee). Cash only payment. Free Order Course: Various Categories - SOLO: male / female / youth. GROUP: adult / family / youth. Registration, Start & Finish Area: Beside the southern car parking area just off the Eairy Kelly road, southern edge of Archallagan Forest, (registration signposted). Event Activity - You have 1 hour to locate as many of the orange & white control flags marked on your map and pin-punch your scorecard to prove that you have visited each location. You can navigate to control flags in whatever order you choose, but remember you are penalised if you return late! events.title: Dylan Moran
events.description: Showtime. What are you going to do? Are you going to go to work? Or stay in bed, chasing oblivion. Guess what? We're fresh out of oblivion.
